7 months in at the placement company; clearly placement year.

'most useful thing I've done'; strongly values the work experience.

Strong independence/growth narrative.
'useful – zero' / 'haven't used anything from uni' is emphatic = strongly disagree, not mild disagree.
'no drawbacks at all', dismisses the anti-placement view; strongly rejects 'nothing gained'.
Identifies with site/contracting and intends to work for the contractor; quote descriptive but path fits, medium ok.
Pride in being 'the actual expert' on monitoring supports technical/specialist; medium ok.
